  class MovingResource(val text: String)
  fun main()
    @Unsafe block
      val handle
        Call getGcHandle
          Call MovingResource
            Binary Add
              StringLiteral "handle-"
              StringLiteral "alive"
      Call gcCollect
      val fromHandle
        Call releaseGcHandle
          Var handle
      Call println
        FieldAccess text
          Var fromHandle
      val pinned
        Call MovingResource

            StringLiteral "alive"

        Call pin
          Var pinned
      Call gcCollect
      val unpinned

          Var pinnedPointer
      Call println

          Var pinned

      Call println
